{{Quote|A small amount leaked out. Must contain. Naboo cannot know.|The Tactical droid on the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]]|<ref name="bsv" />}}
This '''T-series tactical droid''', along with three [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]], scouted the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] Grassy plains before being destroyed by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]. It was later reactivated to garner more information about the Separatists' activities on Naboo.

==History==
{{Quote|Lab must remain secret."<br />"A secret lab on Naboo? Where? You must tell&mdash;"<br />"It is a ''secret''. This is no Separatist ship.|The Tactical droid to [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="bsv" />}}
[[File:Tactical_droid_naboo.png|thumb|left|250px|The tactical droid being interrogated]]

While scouting the plains of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], presumably under orders of [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]], the droid was discovered by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Naboo Royal Guard]], under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]], and shot down, along with three [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]]. The droids' remains were taken back to [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] to be scanned and reactivated without its [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]]. [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] tried to fish out any information about the droid's assignment on Naboo, as instructed by [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], by telling him he was onboard a Separatist ship. The droid uttered something about a virus, specifically about a leak of a small amount from a secret laboratory.<ref name="bsv" />

As Threepio asked the droid more, the tactical droid realized that it wasn't on a Separatist ship at all. Typho put the droid at blasterpoint and said it would have to reveal information on the lab if it wished to survive. [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], who was trying to catch a [[Slug-beetle/Legends|slug-beetle]], got his tongue stuck on an R2 unit dome and knocked over some shelves, which toppled over and crushed the droid. However, Padmé noticed the mud on the droid, recognizing it as mud from the Naboo swamp, which eventually led to the discovery of [[Trade Federation laboratory/Legends|Vindi's laboratory]].<ref name="bsv" />

==Behind the scenes==
This [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] was voiced by [[Phil LaMarr]], who also voiced Admiral [[Trench/Legends|Trench's]] [[TI-99/Legends|tactical droid]] [[Cat and Mouse|later]] in the series.
